description:
lend_process (src/compiler2/source.rs:213-218) takes the Process out of its
RefCell by swapping in `Self::fresh_process()`, runs the callback, then
swaps the real one back and discards the placeholder. fresh_process
(source.rs:~200-211) builds a Node with three atom strings and a Process
around it, so every lend constructs and drops a whole Process that nothing
ever uses.

Change: lending does not construct a value. Either the callback receives
`&mut Process` under one borrow_mut, or the cell holds Option<Process> and
lend takes / puts it, with a loud panic on a nested lend.

Before building: list the lend_process callers and establish why the
callback signature is FnOnce(Process) -> (Process, Result<..>) -- whether
any caller needs the Process by value (moves it into something) or whether
`&mut Process` serves all of them. Check for re-entrant lends: a nested
lend today silently sees the placeholder; after this change it must fail
loudly.

Removal ledger: the placeholder construction per lend, both mem::replace
calls, and fresh_process itself if no other caller remains.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement.
title: Lending the quoted-source process constructs nothing
